label: Snapshot for the demo, built by hand on November 15, 2026 from public headlines. Not live data, not investment advice.
method: Built by hand on November 15, 2026. For each of the 14 catalog tickers we searched the web for recent, publicly reported news (company results releases, SEC EDGAR filings and news sites, dated October 21 to November 12, 2026) and opened every page we cite; each evidence quote is copied from that page and is at most 25 words. Each article was scored by hand with the same strict schema the model will use (event type, direction -1 to 1, materiality 0 to 1, confidence 0 to 1, opinion or not). Market commentary is marked as opinion, so its materiality counts at most 0.2. Mood per asset is aggregateMood in web/lib/themes/mood.ts at the asOf date: sum(direction x materiality x confidence x source trust x e^(-age / 3 days)) / sum(weights), clamped to -1..1. Source trust: SEC EDGAR filings 1.0, press-release and news wires 0.9, other sites and company newsrooms 0.6, social 0.3. materialRisk is materialRiskFlag: a negative item with materiality 0.7 or more, confirmed by an SEC filing or by 2 independent sources, within 14 days of asOf. valueScore is 0 for every asset: no verified price history (52-week high, 200-day average) is wired in yet, so no value reading is guessed. hype is false for every asset: no mention-volume spike or Fear and Greed reading above 80 was measured. Moods and flags are frozen at this date and will go stale. Not live data, not investment advice.
